$comment: Body-of-knowledge coverage register. Every method gap found by the 2026-10-06 BoK gap analysis is an item here and may never be removed. Enforced by src/test/bok-coverage.test.ts: kernel_verified items must have code, exports and tests that exercise each export and a refusal path; owned_by_open_pr items must name the PR and the handover; open items must state the next step; no critical item may be open; register rows tied to a kernel may not be green until the kernel is customer-reachable; every BOK tag in src/lib must resolve to an item here.

items.title: Confidence bounds on Weibull life data, B-lives and Weibayes
items.nextStep: Wire weibullFisherBounds into runReliabilityLifeDataAgent so every life-data report carries the beta interval and B10 bounds.

items.title: Repairable-system trend tests, renewal gate and mean cumulative function
items.nextStep: Call renewalGate before any Weibull fit on inter-arrival times in the life-data agent and surface the verdict on /reliability.

items.title: JA1011 RCM decision logic and quantitative FMECA mode criticality (IEC 60812 / MIL-STD-1629A)
items.handover: PR #624 (agent/rcm-decision-logic) owns RCM and FMEA. Its diff implements the seven-question workflow, consequence branches and tenant-scale FMECA ranks. It does not contain quantitative mode criticality (Cm = beta x alpha x lambda x t). Handed over to #624 rather than built in parallel.
items.nextStep: Confirm with #624 whether quantitative mode criticality lands there or in a follow-up kernel.

items.title: Failure-finding interval for hidden failures of non-SIF protective devices
items.handover: PR #624 owns the hidden-failure gate in the RCM workflow; its diff has no failure-finding interval calculation (target unavailability from device MTBF). The calculation belongs inside that hidden-failure branch, so it is handed over to #624.
items.nextStep: Add an FFI kernel (single and redundant devices) consumed by #624's hidden-failure branch.

items.title: Quantitative risk-based inspection planning (API RP 580-aligned)
items.nextStep: Feed PressureIntegrity circuits, CML corrosion rates and owner-licensed API 581 values into planRiskBasedInspection, and adopt the result through record_inspection_plan.
